name: Coin Values: Coin Identifier
subtitle: Scan Old Coins Worth Money
promotionalText: Snap the front and back of a coin to see its year, mint mark, rarity and an estimated value. Save your coins and track your collection's total.
description:
Found an old coin and wondering what it's worth? Coin Values identifies coins from a photo of the front and back and shows you the details collectors care about, along with an estimated value range.

IDENTIFY A COIN IN SECONDS
• Photograph the front and back, or choose photos from your library
• See the country, denomination, year and mint mark
• Learn the series, metal composition and a little history
• Get tips on varieties and details worth checking

SEE AN ESTIMATED VALUE
• An estimated value range for the coin in the condition shown
• A rarity rating from Common to Very Rare
• A plain explanation of what drives the coin's value
• A confidence level, so you know when to take a closer look

BUILD YOUR COLLECTION
• Save the coins you own with one tap
• See the total estimated value of your collection
• Sort by value, year or date added, and add your own notes
• Your collection is stored on your iPhone

About value estimates: values are AI estimates of a typical retail range and are for information only. They are not a professional appraisal. For coins that may be valuable, have them authenticated and graded by a professional service.

How identification works: the photos you take are sent to Anthropic's Claude AI to identify the coin. The app asks for your permission before your first scan, and photos are not stored on our servers.

COIN VALUES PRO
Identifying coins requires a Coin Values Pro subscription:
• Weekly: $4.99 per week
• Yearly: $29.99 per year, with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers
Prices may vary by country and are shown in the app before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase, or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://jimtarfas.github.io/coin-values-site/privacy.html
reviewNotes:
Coin Values identifies coins from photos. To test:
1. Finish the three onboarding screens. The Coin Values Pro paywall appears (it can be closed with the X).
2. Subscribe with a sandbox account (the yearly plan has a 3-day free trial), or tap Restore Purchases.
3. On the Scan tab tap Scan a Coin, agree to the AI consent screen, then photograph the front and back of any coin. If you have no coin at hand, tap the photo button to pick coin photos from the library, or search the web for a coin image (for example a US quarter) and photograph your screen.
4. The result shows the year, mint mark, rarity and an estimated value. Tap Add to Collection, then open the Collection tab to see the total estimated value.

Identification uses Anthropic's Claude model through our server. Photos are processed in real time and not stored; the app asks for consent before the first scan (Settings > Allow AI Identification shows and changes it). Values are clearly labelled as estimates throughout the app.

Subscriptions: weekly ($4.99) and yearly ($29.99 with a 3-day free trial). Restore Purchases, Terms of Use and Privacy Policy links are on the paywall and in Settings.
